# CEX blocks

You can use the `blocks` function to read source data into a Vector of `Block` objects. 

This example using the `FileReader` type from `CitableBase` to indiate we should from a local file. The file in this example has two blocks, one labelled `ctscatalog` and one labelled `ctsdata`.

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false
using Pkg
Pkg.add("CitableBase")
```
```{julia}
using CiteEXchange
using CitableBase

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cite-architecture/CiteEXchange.jl/refs/heads/main/test/assets/burneyex.cex"
blocklist = blocks(url, UrlReader)
```


Each `Block` has a label and an array of data lines.  You can work directly with the array of blocks:

```{julia}
label(blocklist[1])
```

```{julia}
data(blocklist[1])
```
